definitions.gloss: one's place; one's station; one's standing; one's limits
definitions.explanation: One's social position, abilities, or means. Often used in expressions about knowing one's limits or acting within one's means.

examples.japanese: {身|み}の{程|ほど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{知|し}れ→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
{身|み}の{程|ほど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦わきまえた→わきまえる：15928_wakimaeru⟧⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧べきだ。
examples.english: You should act in accordance with your station.

examples.japanese: {身|み}の{程|ほど}⟦{知|し}ら→知る：00458_shiru⟧ず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧しまった⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{意外|いがい}→意外：12741_igai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{受|う}け{入|い}れて→受け入れる：05755_ukeireru⟧⟦もらえた→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I had the audacity to offer my opinion to the CEO, but surprisingly it was accepted.

notes:
USAGE:
Most commonly appears in set expressions. {身|み}の{程|ほど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{知|し}る→知る：00458_shiru⟧ (to know one's place) and {身|み}の{程|ほど}⟦{知|し}ら→知る：00458_shiru⟧ず (not knowing one's place) are the most frequent. Can sound harsh or old-fashioned when used to tell someone to stay in their lane.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {身|み}の{程|ほど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{知|し}る→知る：00458_shiru⟧ (to know one's place)
- {身|み}の{程|ほど}⟦{知|し}ら→知る：00458_shiru⟧ず (not knowing one's place; presumptuous)
- {身|み}の{程|ほど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦わきまえる→わきまえる：15928_wakimaeru⟧ (to be aware of one's standing)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {分際|ぶんざい}: one's status/position — harsher, used to put someone down
- ⟦{身分|みぶん}→身分：00278_mibun⟧: social standing, status — more neutral, refers to official rank or position
